decision: Weight -5 is the strongest current off-belly candidate: nominal complete-chain walking/stops have no sampled torso contact; randomized support falls substantially with small tracking tradeoffs and no configured failure. It is NOT universally off-belly:235/288 correlated idle world-segments have mean<=1%BW, but worst mean is10.50%BW and nearly every scored sample in that world carries >1%BW. Keep uninstalled pending targeted recorded-startup diagnostics and physical/TA checks. Do not describe the diagnostic0/288 over10%BW-for->1s result as absence of sustained lighter support.
limitations: 10%BW persistence and0.1%/1% near-zero bins are descriptive engineering diagnostics, not class pass criteria.
Support spans use first-to-last consecutive observed samples; neither GPU prior-20ms force means nor52Hz native samples establish between-sample continuity.
Stopping uses endpoint-inclusive50Hz samples below.02m/s planar and.05rad/s yaw for.5s; it is a measurement definition, not hardware approval.
GPU contact-slip metric is contact-gated foot-site horizontal speed. Native exact contact-point Jacobians account for body/joint rotation; they are different metrics.
Native full-hull lower-leg mesh contacts dominate load at the foot endpoint and have effective friction1.0; spheres have0.8. Native is not a literal replay of GPU material randomization.
Native nominal body-angle screen is60degrees at52Hz; numerical warnings are checked520Hz. It is a bounded descriptor diagnostic, not exact per-stage production default stop semantics.
Nominal mechanics keeps sensor noise/latency/reset randomness in GPU; native omits those uncertainties.
